AssayDetails: Buffer scrub samples from the untreated legs of Caucasian, Black and Hispanic consumers
objectives: Primary Objective: To investigate the biology of dry and non-dry skin in a multi-cultural population in the USA.   Secondary Objective: To investigate whether there are differences in the biology of dry and non-dry skin between African American, Hispanic and Caucasian women in the USA.  Primary Outcome Measures: • Visual dryness/ashiness (leg), Skin hydration (corneometer) (leg)  Secondary Outcome Measures:  • Skin barrier (TEWL) (leg), Protein/NMF/Cohesivity via tape strips (leg), Lipids via tape  strips (leg) • Microbiome/Protein Biomarkers via buffer scrubs (leg), pH (leg) • L*a*b* assessments (chromameter) (arm)  Exploratory Outcome Measures: • VISIA imaging (face), Visual Grading (TBD)(face) • Smartphone image (leg) • Visiocan (leg)
